data.name: Ishaan
data.gender_notes: Ishaan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit īś, 'to rule, own' — īśāna, 'ruler, lord'; also the north-east direction. Its root is Sanskrit īś (ईश्). A name of Shiva and of the sun. Ishaan is a Sanskrit name meaning “The sun; (also) Shiva; the north-east”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ishaan expresses “The sun; (also) Shiva; the north-east”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit īś, 'to rule, own' — īśāna, 'ruler, lord'; also the north-east direction.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ishaan total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'ish' (ईश्) which means 'to be', 'to rule', 'to lord over'. Ishaan is a common name for gods in Hinduism and Jainism. It is also a name for the lord Shiva and Vishnu.
